title: Change of control with termination right

pages.text:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement is entered into by and between Alder Manufacturing Co. ("Alder") and Birchfield Labs LLC ("Birchfield").

Section 8. Change of Control. In the event of a change of control of Birchfield, Alder may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice.

Executed by both parties. Signature: Dana Whitfield, CEO, Alder. Signature: Morgan Hale, Manager, Birchfield.

evidence.quote: In the event of a change of control of Birchfield, Alder may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice.

expected.rationale: Explicit change-of-control trigger (ownership change at Birchfield) with a stated termination consequence. Fully signed and no liability language, so no other category applies.
